body:
Nice that we now have a detailed overview.

We should also keep in mind to insert the least default CSS styling needed. Every css style we insert will be one that the users will need to override.

The styling default you proposed are the good ones (and doing them with BEM will be cool), dunno if we need more.

Providing no style (or very few) and `cssClasses` allows our users to just re-add or add classes they already have.

We added quite a lot of css style for the slider because that's one that do not work without any style.
